أرتقي (form VIII)
# أَرْتَقِي (ʔartaqī) /ʔar.ta.qiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# أَرْتَقِيَ (ʔartaqiya) /ʔar.ta.qi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
